newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight rates decline, one-week narrow.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight rates decline, one-week narrow.

text.p: Egyptian pound overnight interbank rates were down on Tuesday in a relatively liquid private sector market to between 10 and 10 3/16 percent from 10 1/4 and 10 3/8 percent on Monday, bankers said.
One-week rates on the pound narrowed in a liquid private sector market at between 10 1/4 and 10 1/8 from Monday's 10 1/4 and 10 3/8.
Public sector banks still maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
